issues.should_add: Complete troubleshooting guide covering common problems, debug flags, and diagnostic techniques
issues.fix_suggestion: Write comprehensive chapter covering: no results problems, performance issues, debug/trace flags, common error patterns, and when to file bugs

issues.description: No documentation for --debug and --trace flags which are essential for troubleshooting
issues.should_add: Document --debug and --trace flags with examples showing the output they produce
issues.fix_suggestion: Add section explaining: --debug shows why files are skipped and search decisions, --trace shows even more detail including regex matching internals. Show example output and when to use each.
issues.source_reference: features.json:debugging_troubleshooting capabilities: 'Debug mode (--debug)', 'Trace mode (--trace)', crates/core/flags/defs.rs:1458-1480 and 6773-6789

issues.description: No guidance for when searches return zero results unexpectedly
issues.should_add: Document common reasons for no results: files ignored by .gitignore, hidden files skipped, binary files filtered, pattern doesn't match
issues.fix_suggestion: Add section with troubleshooting steps: 1) Use --debug to see why files are skipped, 2) Try -uuu to search everything, 3) Check if files are binary with --debug, 4) Verify pattern with simpler test case, 5) Check case sensitivity with -i
issues.source_reference: Bug report template mentions common issues, features.json file_filtering capabilities show default filtering behavior

issues.description: No documentation for diagnosing and solving performance problems
issues.should_add: Document performance troubleshooting: --stats flag, regex complexity, file filtering, thread count, memory mapping
issues.fix_suggestion: Add section covering: Use --stats to see search statistics, avoid complex PCRE2 patterns, use -g/-t to reduce file count, try --mmap for large files, adjust --threads if needed. Explain common performance bottlenecks.
issues.source_reference: features.json:debugging_troubleshooting 'Statistics output (--stats)', performance_tuning category, GUIDE.md mentions performance penalties

issues.description: No documentation of common error messages and their solutions
issues.should_add: Document common errors: leading dash/hyphen in pattern, regex too large, encoding errors, permission denied
issues.fix_suggestion: Add section with common errors and solutions: 'pattern starts with -' → use 'rg -- -pattern' or 'rg -e -pattern', 'regex too large' → use --regex-size-limit or simpler pattern, 'binary file matches' → use -a to search binary files
issues.source_reference: Bug report template .github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/bug_report.yml:10 mentions leading dash issue, FAQ.md has common problems

issues.description: No documentation for --no-messages flag which suppresses error messages
issues.should_add: Document --no-messages flag for suppressing ignore/error messages
issues.fix_suggestion: Add note that --no-messages suppresses non-fatal error messages like ignore file parse errors. Useful when errors are expected and noisy.

issues.description: No documentation for troubleshooting binary file search issues
issues.should_add: Explain how ripgrep detects binary files (NUL byte heuristic) and how to override with -a/--text or --binary
issues.fix_suggestion: Add section: ripgrep skips binary files by default. Use --debug to see 'binary file matches (but not printed)' messages. Use -a to search binary files anyway, or -uuu for unrestricted search.
issues.source_reference: features.json:file_filtering 'Binary file filtering (--binary, --no-binary)', GUIDE.md:725-754 explains binary detection

issues.description: No guidance for when .gitignore or other ignore files cause unexpected behavior
issues.should_add: Document how to diagnose ignore file issues using --debug and how to bypass with -u flags
issues.fix_suggestion: Add troubleshooting steps: 1) Use --debug to see which ignore files are being used, 2) Use -u to ignore .gitignore, 3) Use --no-ignore-vcs or other specific --no-ignore-* flags, 4) Check parent directories for ignore files
issues.source_reference: features.json:file_filtering 'Gitignore support', 'No ignore options', GUIDE.md discusses ignore file behavior

issues.description: No guidance for troubleshooting regex pattern errors
issues.should_add: Document common regex mistakes and how to diagnose them
issues.fix_suggestion: Add section: Common regex errors include unescaped special chars (use -F for literal search), backreferences in default mode (need -P for PCRE2), lookaround in default mode (need -P), pattern too complex (try simpler pattern or --regex-size-limit)
issues.source_reference: features.json:regex_support shows default vs PCRE2 capabilities, FAQ.md #fancy discusses lookaround/backreferences

issues.description: No documentation for using --stats to diagnose performance and search behavior
issues.should_add: Document --stats flag output and how to interpret the statistics
issues.fix_suggestion: Add section showing example --stats output and explaining: files searched, matches found, bytes searched, time elapsed. Useful for understanding search scope and performance.

issues.description: No guidance on when to file a bug report vs user error
issues.should_add: Provide guidance on distinguishing bugs from user error and how to prepare a good bug report
issues.fix_suggestion: Add section: Before filing a bug, 1) Check FAQ and GUIDE, 2) Run with --debug to gather diagnostic info, 3) Try to reproduce with minimal example, 4) Check if it's a known issue from bug template (leading dash, package issues, etc.), 5) Include --debug output in bug report
issues.source_reference: .github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/bug_report.yml shows common non-bugs and required information

issues.description: No documentation for checking if PCRE2 support is available
issues.should_add: Document --pcre2-version flag to check PCRE2 availability and JIT support
issues.fix_suggestion: Add note: Use --pcre2-version to check if ripgrep was compiled with PCRE2 support and whether JIT is available. If not available, -P flag will fail.

issues.description: No troubleshooting guidance for character encoding problems
issues.should_add: Document how to diagnose and fix encoding-related search failures
issues.fix_suggestion: Add brief section: If searching non-UTF-8 files, use -E/--encoding to specify encoding (e.g., -E latin1). Use --debug to see encoding errors. See file-encoding chapter for details.
issues.source_reference: features.json:regex_support 'Encoding specification (-E/--encoding)', link to file-encoding chapter

issues.description: No documentation of exit code semantics for troubleshooting scripts
issues.fix_suggestion: Add brief note explaining exit codes for scripting: exit 0 = match found, exit 1 = no match found, exit 2 = error occurred. Useful with -q for conditional logic.
issues.source_reference: features.json:debugging_troubleshooting 'Exit code semantics', common-options chapter documents -q flag
